description: Search the same way the app’s Home and Live search does. query is the typed text (a team, game, player or market name, e.g. "Bears" or "Rasmussen"); category is games (default), players or markets. Optional league (LGUE_ id) or sport (SPRT_ id) narrows it, limit is 1-20 and cursor is the previous result’s next. Games come back recently started first, then upcoming; each carries its eventId for get_box_score, price_shop_slip or the board. Players carry playerId and team; markets carry selectionId, market, side and line. Search results are names and ids only: no prices or scores.
name: search_markets
title: Search games, players and markets
